title: Founded Didi Dache in 2012 and pursued rapid growth via the 2015
statement: Founded Didi Dache in 2012 and pursued rapid growth via the 2015 Kuaidi Dache merger and 2016 Uber China acquisition.

title: Proceeded with a $4
statement: Proceeded with a $4.4 billion NYSE IPO on June 30, 2021, days before Chinese regulators opened a cybersecurity investigation into the company.
outcome: The Cyberspace Administration of China fined Didi Global 8.026 billion yuan (~$1.2 billion) in July 2022 for data-security violations, fined Cheng Wei and Jean Liu Qing 1 million yuan each personally, and the company delisted from the NYSE in June 2022 before regaining permission to resume new user registrations in China in early 2023.
